name: BG2VN (Benchmark Graph Generator for Vital Node Recognition)
description: A benchmark graph generator designed to produce testbeds for vital (influential) node recognition tasks across synthetic and configurable graph instances.
reputation: A recent academic benchmark generator (2025) that is gaining attention in graph-learning and network-analysis research but has limited mainstream adoption so far.
notes: Synthetic graph generator focused on vital-node tasks; not an LLM benchmark. Results can be sensitive to generator parameterization and prone to algorithm-specific overfitting; ensure varied graph configurations to avoid saturation.
